'''Ch'hodos's red sun''' was a [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Star/Legends|star]]<ref name="SWTOR" /> that was located in the [[Ch'hodos system/Legends|Ch'hodos system]]. It was a part of the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="Trans-Hydian" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] containing the star was surrounded by the [[Nebula/Legends|nebulosity]] of the [[Stygian Caldera]],<ref name="TEA" /> and was known as the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The Ch'hodos [[Star system/Legends|system]] was linked via [[Nache Bhelfia]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Krayiss Two system|Krayiss]] and [[Ziost system/Legends|Ziost systems]], while the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route known as [[Zorfe Trete]] connected it to the [[Ashas Ree system/Legends|Ashas Ree system]].<ref name="TEA" />

The red star was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ch'hodos]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date TOR">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Under a Red Star" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the game, the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] emitted from Ch'hodos's sun had increased, causing [[Mutant|mutations]] in the planet's [[Desert/Legends|desert]] life-forms.<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
An individual visiting Ch'hodos at that [[Time/Legends|time]] discovered [[Skeleton/Legends|skeletons]] of mutated creatures inside a [[Cave/Legends|cave]], which suggested that the planet's sun had cyclically gone through similar changes in radiation output in the past.<ref name="SWTOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ch'hodos's red sun was mentioned in a Bioanalysis Crew Skill mission of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]], though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="SWTOR" /> The Ch'hodos system, and therefore the red sun, was placed in grid square R-4 by the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="TEA" />
